babs.2: The pen has dried upon Allah's knowledge; "and Allah has sent him astray knowingly"
babs.3: Allah knows best what they would have done
babs.4: "And the command of Allah is a decree determined"
babs.5: Deeds are judged by their endings
babs.6: The vow casts the servant to the decree
babs.7: "La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah"
babs.8: Protected is the one whom Allah protects; 'asim means preventer
babs.9: "And it is forbidden for a town which We have destroyed that they would return"
babs.10: "And We did not make the vision which We showed you except as a trial for the people"
babs.11: Adam and Musa argued before Allah
babs.12: None can withhold what Allah gives
babs.13: Whoever sought refuge with Allah from being overtaken by misery and from an evil decree
babs.14: "He intervenes between a man and his heart"
babs.15: "Say: Nothing will befall us except what Allah has decreed for us"
babs.16: "We would not have been guided had Allah not guided us"
